entries.en: At last... The power to reclaim what is mine. What is <italic(1)>ours<italic(0)>...
entries.macro: At last... The power to reclaim what is mine. What is <italic(1)>ours<italic(0)>...
entries.fr: Le nimbe royal... Je vais enfin pouvoir rompre le sceau de l'épée et libérer son vrai pouvoir...
entries.ja:
おお…… これが「女王の光輪」と呼ばれし ボズヤ･クリスタル……
今こそ 聖剣セイブ・ザ・クイーンの 真の力を解き放とうぞ……
entries.jaMacro:

entries.en:
The will of Queen Gunnhildr shall not be denied.
All who oppose Bozja must fall.
entries.macro:
The will of Queen Gunnhildr shall not be denied.
All who oppose Bozja must fall.
entries.fr: Moi et la lame sacrée de Bozja accomplirons la dernière volonté de Gunnhildr... et exterminerons tous ceux qui ont bafoué notre nom...
entries.ja:
我 女王グンヒルドの遺志を継ぎ 聖剣とともに
ボズヤに仇なす者どもを 討ち滅ぼさん……

entries.en: By the gods... She has become a vessel for the blade's power!
entries.fr: Garde-la-Reine, sous sa véritable forme<nbsp>! Nous arrivons trop tard<nbsp>!
entries.ja: あれが真の闘神――  セイブ・ザ・クイーン！
entries.frMacro: Garde-la-Reine, sous sa véritable forme<nbsp>! Nous arrivons trop tard<nbsp>!
entries.speaker: MIKOTO

entries.en:
No... No, we have suffered too long for it to end this way.
Bozja is ours! If we cannot have it, no one will!
entries.macro:

entries.fr: Non<nbsp>! Je porte en moi l'amertume de tout un peuple... Bozja mérite de subir notre furie<nbsp>!!!
entries.ja:
馬鹿な…… 我が怨み…… 我が一族の怨みを晴らさねば……
憎きボズヤに 我が怒りの鉄槌をッ！！！
